_comment: RPI seasons each long-standing D1 program published on main at 5afc045b (public/data/programs/index.json, rpiHistory years), and whether it published a 2025 lastSeason with a record. tests/seasons_test.py requires every such program still published in D1 to keep at least these seasons: past RPI seasons do not disappear, so the set can only grow. It is read from committed output, not from the registry ids or the RPI loaders, so a fault shared by the build and the tests expectations still shows here. Edit an entry only for a reviewed correction to a program RPI join.
